1.consolidated_definition: Dícese de la persona que no cambia de ideas políticas o de partido.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
This is said of a person who does not change their political ideas or party affiliation.

Alternatively:

One who maintains the same political views or party allegiance throughout.

Or more formally:

A person characterized by steadfast adherence to their original political convictions or partisan identity.
